record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare MUDDY_WATER: Shellos (West Sea, 1 star) and Gastrodon (West Sea, 2 stars). The strategy is shared; only the damage depends on the casting unit's stars. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Hits every enemy standing in the three cells adjacent to the caster in the direction of its target (the facing cell and the two cells 45 degrees to either side). Each enemy takes special damage (raw 40 / 80 / 160 / 320 by caster stars: 40 for the 1-star Shellos, 80 for the 2-star Gastrodon; x(1 + AP/100), crit factor only with ABILITY_CRIT, then reduced by the victim's special defense with a minimum of 1), then gets Armor Reduction for 4000 ms and Wound for 4000 ms (both fixed, not star-scaled; after duration reductions). Armor reduction halves def and speDef (rounded) in damage calculations; wound removes all healing. Both statuses are applied regardless of whether the damage was blocked.

targeting.who: every enemy in the up-to-3 cells adjacent to the caster toward its target
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the default true; the target argument only defines the facing. The facing is one of 8 directions from the signs of dx / dy toward the target, not an exact angle, so a target far away along a knight-move still yields a diagonal or orthogonal facing. Only enemies are hit; allies in the cone are ignored.

geometry.shape: cone of the 3 cells adjacent to the caster: the facing cell and the two neighbouring orientations (+/-45 degrees); with the default range 1 the cone never extends past the adjacent ring; off-board cells dropped; the caster orientation is updated as a side effect

declaredRaw.label: raw special damage by caster stars (requested amount)

effects.scaling: requested = 40 (Shellos, 1 star) / 80 (Gastrodon, 2 stars). Applied: x(1 + caster AP / 100) (apBoost default true), x2 if the caster is enraged, crit factor 1 + (critPower - 1) x reduction only if crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: no damage if the victim has protect, skydiving or magicBounce (magicBounce can reflect part to the caster). Then PokemonState.handleDamage: special damage / (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef) where speDef is halved (rounded) if the victim already has armorReduction, minimum 1 after Math.ceil, shield absorbs first. Because the damage call precedes the armor-reduction call for the same victim, this cast's own armor reduction does not reduce its own damage. Three amounts: requested = table; applied = after AP / crit / defense / floor of 1; takenDamage (returned, unused here) = shield + hp actually lost.

declaredRaw.description: triggerArmorReduction(4000, victim) then triggerWound(4000, victim, caster)

effects.scaling: fixed 4000 ms each, independent of stars, AP and crit

statusEffects.scaling: fixed 4000 ms, no AP, crit or star factor
statusEffects.resolution: Requested 4000 ms; applied only if the victim has no rune protect. Duration after SWIFT_SWIM x0.7 / HYDRATION x0.5 / WATER_VEIL or SURGE_SURFER x0.3 and Odd Keystone -10% each; it replaces the remaining time only if longer (rounded). While active def and speDef count as half (rounded) in handleDamage. Ends when the cooldown runs out.

declaredRaw.label: fixed duration before weather and reductions

statusEffects.scaling: fixed 4000 ms, no AP, crit or star factor
statusEffects.resolution: Requested 4000 ms; applied unless the victim has rune protect. x1.3 under BLOODMOON weather, then the same water-ability and Odd Keystone reductions. It replaces the remaining time (and the origin, the caster) only if longer. While wounded the victim receives no healing (handleHeal returns 0 healed), except the Bloodmoon + Blood Stone shield branch.

starBehavior.note: Only the damage table is indexed by the casting entity's stars (fallback 320); the two status durations are fixed. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Which cells are hit depends on the direction from the caster to its target (sign-based, 8 directions); only the three cells adjacent to the caster in that direction count. A target farther than one cell away is not itself hit unless it stands in one of those cells.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast spends maxPP of PP. Re-application only extends armor reduction and wound if the new duration is longer than what remains; the wound origin is replaced only then.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: special damage 40 / 80 raw, armor reduction 4000 ms, wound 4000 ms. Applied: damage after AP, enrage, crit, speDef (halved if already armor-reduced before the hit) and the floor of 1; statuses after rune-protect, Bloodmoon, water-ability and Odd Keystone changes. No immunity effect guards these two statuses beyond rune protect.
